drums.tags: Industrial techno with heavy distortion and mechanical textures. A distorted kick drum plays a steady four-on-the-floor pattern with a long, saturated decay. A high-pitched, resonant synth pulse repeats on every sixteenth note, processed with a rhythmic gate and bitcrushing. A metallic, percussive sequence with heavy reverb provides a syncopated counter-rhythm. The track features a constant low-frequency drone with a slow filter sweep. 135 BPM. Key of D minor. 4/4 time signature. High-frequency white noise bursts occur every four bars. The mix is heavily compressed with a prominent sidechain pumping effect triggered by the kick drum.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum, resonant sixteenth-note synth pulse]

[Section A]
[metallic percussive sequence enters, heavy reverb]
[low-frequency drone with slow filter sweep]

[Section B]
[white noise bursts every four bars]
[increased bitcrushing on synth pulse]
[sidechain pumping effect intensifies]

bass.tags: Experimental percussion ensemble piece. The arrangement consists of a deep, resonant kick drum, a high-pitched wooden rimshot or woodblock, and a metallic shaker. The kick drum performs a syncopated pattern emphasizing the downbeat and the upbeat of two. The woodblock executes a repetitive eighth-note pattern with occasional syncopated accents. The shaker maintains a steady sixteenth-note subdivision. The tempo is 110 BPM in 4/4 time. The recording features a dry acoustic environment with minimal artificial reverb, emphasizing the transient attack of the percussion instruments.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[deep kick drum enters with syncopated pattern]
[metallic shaker enters with sixteenth-note rhythm]

[Main Section]
[high-pitched woodblock enters with eighth-note accents]
[kick drum continues syncopated pulse]
[shaker maintains steady subdivision]
